instruction:
You are a mechanical fire-protection engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-11 fire-main hydraulic and seismic support package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. NFPA-style fire-main checks, Hazen-Williams calculations, ASME-style piping support workflows, and seismic bracing coordination routes shape the workflow context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product family: `SSC-11-LH-02`
- Fire-main route: `FIRE-SSC11-002`
- Flow basis: `FLOW-SSC11-002`
- Support detail: `SUP-SSC11-002`
- Pump basis: `PUMP-SSC11-002`
- Coordination memo: `MEMO-SSC11-002`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Design fire flow | {{ fire_flow_l_s }} L/s |
| Main length | {{ main_length_m }} m |
| Hydraulic internal diameter | {{ pipe_internal_diameter_mm }} mm |
| Hazen-Williams C | {{ hazen_williams_c }} |
| Riser elevation | {{ riser_elevation_m }} m |
| Remote head flow | {{ remote_head_flow_l_min }} L/min |
| Remote head count | {{ remote_head_count }} |
| Source residual pressure | {{ source_residual_pressure_kpa }} kPa |
| Pump boost pressure | {{ pump_boost_pressure_kpa }} kPa |
| Required remote residual pressure | {{ required_remote_pressure_kpa }} kPa |
| Support span | {{ support_span_m }} m |
| Support pipe outer diameter | {{ pipe_outer_diameter_mm }} mm |
| Support pipe wall thickness | {{ pipe_wall_thickness_mm }} mm |
| Water density | {{ water_density_kg_m3 }} kg/m3 |
| Steel density | {{ steel_density_kg_m3 }} kg/m3 |
| Seismic horizontal coefficient | {{ seismic_horizontal_coefficient }} |
| Vertical support allowable | {{ support_vertical_allowable_kn }} kN |
| Horizontal support allowable | {{ support_horizontal_allowable_kn }} kN |

## Checks

- Hazen-Williams loss equals `10.67 x length x flow^1.852 / (C^1.852 x diameter^4.871)`, using m3/s and m.
- Friction loss in kPa equals head loss times `9.81`.
- Remote demand equals `remote_head_flow_l_min x remote_head_count / 60`.
- Remote pressure equals source residual plus pump boost minus friction loss minus elevation pressure.
- Support line load includes pipe annulus steel weight plus contents weight.
- Vertical reaction equals line load times support span.
- Seismic horizontal reaction equals vertical reaction times the horizontal coefficient.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when flow margin, remote pressure margin, and both support utilizations pass; otherwise it is `0.0`.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the object IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "hazen_williams_loss_m": <numeric_value>,
  "friction_loss_kpa": <numeric_value>,
  "remote_flow_demand_l_s": <numeric_value>,
  "fire_flow_margin_l_s": <numeric_value>,
  "remote_pressure_kpa": <numeric_value>,
  "remote_pressure_margin_kpa": <numeric_value>,
  "support_line_load_kn_m": <numeric_value>,
  "support_vertical_reaction_kn": <numeric_value>,
  "seismic_horizontal_reaction_kn": <numeric_value>,
  "support_vertical_utilization": <numeric_value>,
  "support_horizontal_utilization": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-11 fire-main hydraulic and seismic support template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one synthetic fire-main source pack with flow, pressure, and support values.

[meta]
name = "fire-main-hydraulic-seismic-support-package"
description = "SSC-11 fire-main flow, residual pressure, and seismic support metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound fire-main hydraulic and support metrics from a deterministic SSC-11 task-owned source pack. The template combines Hazen-Williams loss, remote fire-head demand, residual pressure, pipe/support dead load, seismic reaction, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "mechanical"
category = "fire-protection"
standards = ["NFPA-style fire-main checks", "Hazen-Williams hydraulic calculations", "ASME-style piping support workflows", "Seismic bracing coordination workflows"]
tags = ["mechanical", "fire-main", "hydraulics", "seismic-support", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.fire_flow_l_s]
type = "float"
unit = "L/s"
description = "FLOW-SSC11-002 design fire flow"
min = 32.0
max = 32.0

[params.main_length_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "FIRE-SSC11-002 fire-main length to the remote branch"
min = 110.18021736015125
max = 110.18021736015125

[params.pipe_internal_diameter_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "FIRE-SSC11-002 hydraulic internal diameter"
min = 150.0
max = 150.0

[params.hazen_williams_c]
type = "float"
description = "FLOW-SSC11-002 Hazen-Williams roughness coefficient"
min = 130.0
max = 130.0

[params.riser_elevation_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "FIRE-SSC11-002 elevation rise to the remote head branch"
min = 5.441896024464831
max = 5.441896024464831

[params.remote_head_flow_l_min]
type = "float"
unit = "L/min"
description = "FIRE-SSC11-002 remote head flow"
min = 95.0
max = 95.0

[params.remote_head_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "FIRE-SSC11-002 active remote head count"
min = 8.0
max = 8.0

[params.source_residual_pressure_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "PUMP-SSC11-002 source residual pressure"
min = 310.0
max = 310.0

[params.pump_boost_pressure_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "PUMP-SSC11-002 pump boost pressure"
min = 260.0
max = 260.0

[params.required_remote_pressure_kpa]
type = "float"
unit = "kPa"
description = "MEMO-SSC11-002 required remote residual pressure"
min = 140.0
max = 140.0

[params.support_span_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "SUP-SSC11-002 support tributary span"
min = 4.196169128523375
max = 4.196169128523375

[params.pipe_outer_diameter_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "SUP-SSC11-002 support pipe outer diameter"
min = 168.3
max = 168.3

[params.pipe_wall_thickness_mm]
type = "float"
unit = "mm"
description = "SUP-SSC11-002 support pipe wall thickness"
min = 7.11
max = 7.11

[params.water_density_kg_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "kg/m3"
description = "FLOW-SSC11-002 water density"
min = 1000.0
max = 1000.0

[params.steel_density_kg_m3]
type = "float"
unit = "kg/m3"
description = "SUP-SSC11-002 steel density"
min = 7850.0
max = 7850.0

[params.seismic_horizontal_coefficient]
type = "float"
description = "SUP-SSC11-002 horizontal seismic coefficient"
min = 0.3
max = 0.3

[params.support_vertical_allowable_kn]
type = "float"
unit = "kN"
description = "SUP-SSC11-002 vertical allowable support reaction"
min = 8.5
max = 8.5

[params.support_horizontal_allowable_kn]
type = "float"
unit = "kN"
description = "SUP-SSC11-002 horizontal allowable support reaction"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[outputs.hazen_williams_loss_m]
description = "Friction head loss through the fire main"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.friction_loss_kpa]
description = "Fire-main friction loss expressed as pressure"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.remote_flow_demand_l_s]
description = "Remote fire-head flow demand"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.fire_flow_margin_l_s]
description = "Design fire-flow margin against remote demand"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.remote_pressure_kpa]
description = "Remote residual pressure after losses and elevation"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.remote_pressure_margin_kpa]
description = "Remote residual pressure margin"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.support_line_load_kn_m]
description = "Pipe and contents line load at the support"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.support_vertical_reaction_kn]
description = "Vertical support reaction"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.seismic_horizontal_reaction_kn]
description = "Horizontal seismic support reaction"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.support_vertical_utilization]
description = "Vertical support utilization"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.support_horizontal_utilization]
description = "Horizontal support utilization"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "Pass score for the task-owned hydraulic and support checks"
tolerance = 0.03
